structured.reason: The "Generous Size, Secure Bottle" section says "the secure cap helps reduce spills." This is defensive framing of a known complaint in the reviews: one reviewer says "I managed to spill the liquid twice," and another says the Luminess bottles "always leaked." Saying the cap "helps reduce spills" reacts to that problem and implies spills still happen, which places it under category 3 (backhanded or defensive framing of a known complaint) and hedge category 2. The rest of the description is plain positive claims or neutral specs. The "up to 10 hours" wording is a mild hedge but is ordinary spec language on its own.
